links.outcome: Readability, understandability and actionability of LLM postoperative care responses across three models
links.effect: Gemini significantly more readable (p=0.001) and understandable (p=0.014; p=0.001) than GPT-3.5 and GPT-4; no difference in actionability (p=0.830); accuracy equal (p=0.849).
links.quote: The three LLMs provided equally accurate information, with GPT-3.5 averaging the highest on the Likert scale (LS) (4.18 ± 0.93) (p = 0.849), while Gemini provided significantly more readable (p = 0.001) and understandable responses (p = 0.014; p = 0.001).

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates commercial LLMs (ChatGPT-3.5, GPT-4, Gemini) on medical accuracy, readability, understandability, and actionability for postoperative patient questions, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
